description: This Java source file defines an Android activity (List8) that demonstrates the use of setEmptyView with a ListView and custom adapter. It includes a nested PhotoAdapter class managing photo resources displayed as images in a list, along with buttons to add or clear photos.

classes.name: List8
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays a list of photos with add and clear functionalities, demonstrating setEmptyView usage.

classes.name: PhotoAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter that manages displaying a list of photo resources, supporting adding and clearing photos.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, adapter, and button click handlers.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of photos currently in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified position; here, the position itself.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the item ID for the specified position; here, the position itself.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns a view (ImageView) for the photo at a specific list position.

methods.name: clearPhotos
methods.description: Clears the list of photos and updates the view.

methods.name: addPhotos
methods.description: Adds a random photo from the pool to the list and updates the view.
